subject.title: feat(agents): sessions_search tool for full-text recall over past session transcripts

question: Should `sessions.search` with `operator.read` be allowed to search the default agent when the caller provides only a query and no session-key allowlist?
rationale: The agent tool always derives visible session keys first, but the public gateway method also exposes a broader query-only path; whether trusted read operators may discover transcript contents is a repository security and product boundary, not a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Require session keys
options.body: Make the RPC require a bounded allowlist so all callers explicitly select sessions before transcript search.

options.title: Allow trusted discovery
options.body: Keep query-only default-agent search and document that `operator.read` includes full-text transcript discovery.

options.title: Keep the RPC private
options.body: Retain the index and agent tool but defer advertising the gateway method until client authorization requirements are settled.

recommendation.title: Require session keys
recommendation.body: Make the RPC require a bounded allowlist so all callers explicitly select sessions before transcript search.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest prior history across the session-tool product surface and current routing and visibility behavior.
